sheets.name: rh_run_1
sheets.action: running (the Darkin's move loop): crouched forward, Rhaast low before him in his claws, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame (the old run played frames 4, 3, 2 again as 6, 7, 8: draw all 8)
sheets.weapons: RHAAST goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): the crimson crescent blade with its red eye on the dark shaft, as big as in image 1 - held in his crimson claws, raised, swung, thrust or planted as the pale figure holds it. The huge horns stay on his helm, the same size as in image 1. Only him and Rhaast: no red mist, no blood trails, no afterimages; the eyes' red stays inside the eyes.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his crimson clawed foot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under his hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot low, just off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the arms and the scythe follow the pale figure. The scythe's blade hangs near the ground but is NOT a leg: his two legs carry him.
